notes: POWO and Flora of North America treat Croton fruticulosus as accepted.
Do not confuse this name with Croton fruticosus.

target_zone_range_leads.guardrail: Deep Review must verify exact target-zone counties; no county inference from state/ecoregion presence.
leads: Master Plant Pool records 57 personal wild observations and Hays Local status; occurrence lead only.
POWO lists Texas in the native range.
Flora of North America describes the U.S. range reaching trans-Pecos Texas to the Edwards Plateau.
BONAP Croton county maps require exact county extraction in Deep Review.

morphology_candidate.look_here_first: Start with growth form and leaf margin: this is the shrubby/subshrubby Croton in the batch, with ovate to ovate-lanceolate leaves and fine serrulation rather than an entire margin.
diagnostic_traits: three styles bifid to six terminal segments

confusers.separator: C. fruticulosus is woody/shrubby with serrulate leaves; C. lindheimeri is an annual herb with entire leaves.
C. texensis is an annual, strictly dioecious, with narrow mostly entire leaves and unisexual inflorescences.
